children: HOOKER FURNISHINGS Corp reported second-quarter 2026 results with revenue of $63.25M, a net income of $1.67M and diluted EPS of $0.15, compared with $69.24M in revenue and a net loss of ($3.28M) in the year-ago quarter.
¹ Reported as “Net sales”. ² Reported as “Net income / (loss)”. ³ Reported as “Diluted loss per share”.
Net sales declined about 8.7% in the quarter and 5.5% year-to-date versus the prior year, driven by lower unit volume across core segments.
Channel dynamics included higher promotional e-commerce discounts and SKU out-of-stocks that pressured volume despite increases in average selling prices.
Margaritaville brand rollout is gaining traction with roughly 100 in‑store galleries and 10 standalone stores; shipments are ramping.
Tariff recoveries materially improved gross margin and liquidity, supporting operating income and cash generation.
Imported upholstery lead-times and first-quarter inventory constraints eased in Q2; backlog was modestly higher.
